testcase.name: Scenario: Reduce the full ribbon to compact group buttons: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:6:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reduce the full ribbon to compact group buttons ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part document is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the View ribbon tab displays its full groups of commands ✔ When the user opens the ribbon display menu ✔ Then Minimize to Panel Buttons is selected ✔ When the user dismisses the menu with Escape ✔ Then the full View ribbon remains visible ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control once ✔ Then the View ribbon shows compact buttons for Visibility, Appearance, Windows and Navigate ✔ And the viewport has more vertical space ✔ When the user selects the Windows group button ✔ Then a temporary panel displays that group's commands ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control again ✔ Then the full View ribbon is restored ✔ And the temporary Windows panel closes
